shortDescription: Thailand’s imports surged 50.4% year-on-year in September 2026, picking up from a 25.1% increase in the previous month and topping market forecasts of 31.3%.It was also the fastest growth since June 2021, driven by export-oriented manufacturing activity and higher global energy prices.

title: Thailand Import Growth Beats Estimates
